user_question: Calculate the mean absolute elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces available for Bellefonte.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate the mean absolute elevation difference between the two elevation surfaces available for Bellefonte.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve Bellefonte analysis zone
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a GeoPackage polygon layer representing Bellefonte for zonal calculation of the raster difference.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked catalog candidate representing the Bellefonte polygon analysis zone. Treat the result as a candidate and retain spatial-coverage and polygon-geometry validation for runtime QC.

workflow_steps.title: Align second elevation raster
workflow_steps.purpose: Resample the second elevation surface to the first surface's raster resolution and grid for valid cellwise comparison.
workflow_steps.instructions: Resample input_2 to the grid of input_1, using a 30 metre target resolution. Preserve the spatial coverage needed for the Bellefonte analysis and produce a GeoTIFF raster. Runtime QC must verify exact grid alignment rather than relying only on nominal resolution.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate absolute elevation difference
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate the cellwise absolute difference between the two aligned elevation surfaces.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate abs(input_1 - aligned_input_2) cell by cell. Use only overlapping valid raster cells and preserve a GeoTIFF raster output suitable for zonal statistics.

workflow_steps.title: Compute mean absolute elevation difference
workflow_steps.purpose: Summarize the absolute elevation-difference raster over the Bellefonte polygon zone.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute the mean of absolute_difference_raster within bellefonte_zone. Return a CSV summary containing the mean absolute elevation difference for the Bellefonte analysis zone. Runtime QC must verify that the retrieved zone is a valid polygon GeoPackage layer and that its CRS is compatible with the raster.

requirements.scope: The retrieved bellefonte_zone candidate must spatially represent Bellefonte.
The retrieved Bellefonte zone must be available as a GeoPackage polygon input for zonal statistics.
aligned_input_2 must have the same grid definition as input_1, including resolution, origin, extent alignment, and cell dimensions.
The aligned second elevation raster must retain the Bellefonte coverage required for comparison.
input_1 and aligned_input_2 must use compatible coordinate reference systems for raster calculation.
input_1 and aligned_input_2 must be cellwise comparable on an identical raster grid.
Both elevation surfaces must cover the Bellefonte analysis area used for the difference calculation.
absolute_difference_raster and bellefonte_zone must have compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
bellefonte_zone must contain valid polygon geometry suitable for zonal statistics.
The zonal-statistics zone input must be a GeoPackage polygon layer and the raster input must be GeoTIFF.
The zone and absolute-difference raster must overlap over the Bellefonte analysis area.
